status_note: Every numeric field is null on purpose. Fill them only from a measured physical board or official CAD. Guessed dimensions or scale taken from an image are forbidden by the review plan.

pixel_frame_convention.rotation_zero_angle_definition: the vector from component body centre to its pin-1 / cathode / positive-lead marker points along +X (to the right in golden.png as stored)
pixel_frame_convention.rotation_period_field: record component symmetry separately (180 for unpolarised two-terminal parts, 360 for polarised or keyed parts)
pixel_frame_convention.rationale: center_x_px/center_y_px are already in golden_board_pixels; the review plan forbids mixing two coordinate spaces inside one record, so rotation_deg must share that frame.

canvas_to_board_design_transform.transform: rotate 180 degrees about the canvas centre (2048.0, 1408.0)
canvas_to_board_design_transform.evidence: all board silkscreen and part markings (GILBARCO LEGACY, DALLAS DS1225AD, ZILOG Z84C0006PEC, RefDes U*/P*/R*) read upside-down on golden.png and correctly after a 180 degree rotation
canvas_to_board_design_transform.note: This is a rotation, not a mirror. Apply it as one explicit documented step when importing or exporting CAD/BOM/PnP data, which is normally expressed in the design-upright frame. Do not apply it silently to stored pixel coordinates.
